Voice.// Notes: Native Danish neural voice for Norlys (real da-DK accent). Alternatives if persona swap requested: da-DK-JeppeNeural (M). Avoid en-* Dragon HD voices on the Danish line — they sound American reading Danish.
Voice.Name: da-DK-ChristelNeural

VoiceLive.// Notes: Phone-tuned (PSTN / 8 kHz G.711). Change these to retune for noisy environments without redeploying code. Spec defaults: Threshold=0.5, PrefixPaddingMs=300, SilenceDurationMs=500, InterruptResponse=true.

Vad.// Threshold: Speech-detection probability 0.0-1.0. Higher = less sensitive to background noise (kids, traffic, line hiss). 0.7 is a phone-friendly default; raise to 0.8 if barge-in still fires on noise.
Vad.// PrefixPaddingMs: Audio buffered BEFORE the speech-onset point. 400 ms preserves leading consonants on PSTN.
Vad.// SilenceDurationMsEnglish: End-of-turn silence for English callers. 500 ms (spec default) is fine for English.
Vad.// SilenceDurationMsOther: End-of-turn silence for non-English (Danish etc.). 900 ms gives Danes room for natural pauses ('øh… altså…') without the bot cutting in.
Vad.// InterruptResponse: If true, caller speech immediately stops the bot mid-sentence (barge-in). Set false to debug noise-triggered cut-offs — the bot will finish its sentence even if VAD mis-fires on background noise.

Transcription.// Notes: Per Voice Live 2025-10-01 spec, only these models are supported with gpt-realtime: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize. azure-speech is NOT supported with gpt-realtime. whisper-1 chosen as default: more stable on short Danish phone-call utterances. gpt-4o-transcribe has lower benchmark WER but well-documented truncation issues on short audio in production.
